mapper.select: SELECT o.ID as orderId, o.ORDER_DATE as orderDate, os.ORDER_STATUS as orderStatus, o.TOTAL_AMOUNT as totalAmount, od.UNIT_PRICE as unitPrice, od.DISCOUNT_PRICE as discountPrice, od.QUANTITY as quantity, os.DESCRIPTION as deliveryStatus, 'dummy_carrier' as carrier, -- Replace this with the actual carrier column if available 'dummy_tracking_number' as trackingNumber, -- Replace this with the actual tracking number column if available CURRENT_DATE as estimatedArrivalDate -- Replace this with the actual estimated arrival date column if available FROM ORDER_TB o JOIN ORDER_DETAIL_TB od ON o.ID = od.ORDER_ID JOIN ORDER_STATUS_TB os ON o.ID = os.ORDER_ID WHERE o.IDENTIFIER_ID = #{customerId} AND o.ORDER_DATE BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY o.ORDER_DATE DESC
